name: Monad
short_description: Parallel-EVM L1 in public testnet phase. On-chain activity is being tracked for the genesis distribution.
description_md: Monad is a high-throughput EVM-compatible L1 that introduces parallel execution and a custom consensus stack. It raised $244M led by Paradigm at a $3B valuation, putting it firmly in the highest-tier-funded testnet of the cycle. The public testnet went live in February 2026 and an explicit testnet incentive program has been hinted at by the team. While no formal airdrop has been confirmed, every team in this funding bracket (Berachain, Eclipse, MegaETH) has historically rewarded testnet usage at genesis. Activity that is most likely to be weighted: native MON-T transactions, deposits to major testnet DEXes, NFT mints on Monad-native marketplaces, validator delegations, and bridge usage.
eligibility_md:
- Have a funded testnet wallet (request from the official faucet, not third parties)
- Complete at least 30 unique daily transactions over a 60-day window
- Use the canonical Monad testnet bridge at least 3 times
- Provide liquidity on at least one testnet DEX (Ambient, Apriori, etc.) for >7 days
- Mint at least one NFT from a Monad-native collection
- Avoid sybil patterns: do not fund multiple wallets from the same source
how_to_claim_md:
1. Visit https://testnet.monad.xyz and connect a fresh wallet — do not reuse a wallet that has touched known sybil farms.
2. Request MON-T from the official faucet (rate-limited; daily drips).
3. Bridge testnet ETH from Sepolia via the canonical bridge.
4. Use Ambient or Apriori for at least 3 swaps per week.
5. Provide LP for 7+ days on a stable pair.
6. Watch the official Monad blog for the genesis snapshot announcement — claim portal will go live there.

faqs.question: Has Monad confirmed an airdrop?
faqs.answer_md: No formal confirmation. The team has acknowledged that testnet activity will be considered for genesis distribution but has not promised a specific allocation.

faqs.question: How do I avoid sybil filters?
faqs.answer_md: Use a single wallet per identity, do not fund from the same CEX address across multiple wallets, and create genuine usage patterns (real LP, real swaps, varied timing). Monad's team has stated they will analyze on-chain heuristics aggressively.

faqs.question: Is KYC required?
faqs.answer_md: No KYC is expected for the genesis claim. Subsequent CEX listings may impose KYC at the exchange level.

faqs.question: When is the snapshot?
faqs.answer_md: Unannounced. Expect a snapshot 2-4 weeks before mainnet launch, which is currently targeted for late 2026.

name: MegaETH
short_description: Real-time blockchain claiming sub-10ms block times; public testnet open with explicit user-activity tracking.
description_md: MegaETH is positioning itself as the first 'real-time' EVM rollup, with sub-10ms preconfirmations and 100,000+ TPS targets. The project raised $30M with backing from Dragonfly, Robot Ventures, and Vitalik Buterin personally, and went live with a public testnet in March 2026. The team has confirmed that public testnet activity will be a meaningful input to the eventual token distribution, making this one of the cleaner testnet farming opportunities in the cycle. Trading, lending, and NFT-mint activity on testnet-native dapps (Cap, GTE, Ducks) are all being indexed.
eligibility_md:
- Bridge testnet ETH to MegaETH via the canonical bridge
- Use at least 3 different testnet-native dapps
- Maintain a 30+ day activity streak
- Hold a positive MegaETH testnet balance at the eventual snapshot
- Engage with at least one perp DEX (GTE) or money market (Cap)
how_to_claim_md:
1. Connect a wallet at testnet.megaeth.com and request testnet ETH from the faucet.
2. Bridge from Sepolia using the canonical bridge.
3. Place at least 5 trades on GTE per week.
4. Lend or borrow on Cap testnet (low value is fine).
5. Mint one Ducks testnet NFT.
6. Claim portal will be announced post-mainnet — do not connect to any 'MegaETH airdrop claim' site before the official announcement.

faqs.question: Is the testnet open to anyone?
faqs.answer_md: Yes — anyone can access testnet.megaeth.com without an invite as of Q1 2026.

faqs.question: What is the expected mainnet date?
faqs.answer_md: Team has not committed publicly. Most signals point to Q4 2026 / Q1 2027.

faqs.question: How is testnet usage measured?
faqs.answer_md: MegaETH has not published the exact scoring formula. Expect diversity of dapps used, total transactions, and recency to all matter.

name: Berachain BGT Boost
short_description: Boost validators with your BGT to earn protocol-level emissions across Berachain's Proof-of-Liquidity ecosystem.
description_md: Berachain's Proof-of-Liquidity consensus issues BGT (governance) to LPs in whitelisted pools. Holders can then 'boost' validators with their BGT, which directs subsequent emissions to chosen reward vaults. The BGT Boost program rewards consistent boosters with weekly USDC + ecosystem token drops from validator-funded incentive pools. Several Berachain-native protocols (Infrared, BeraBorrow, Honeypot) co-incentivize on top, layering additional yield. Boost positions can be modified weekly. Total emissions are several hundred thousand dollars per week across the validator set.
eligibility_md:
- Acquire BGT by providing liquidity in any whitelisted BPL pool
- Delegate (Boost) your BGT to at least one active validator
- Hold the boost position across at least one full weekly epoch
- Optionally: layer with Infrared or BeraBorrow for additional yield
how_to_claim_md:
1. Go to hub.berachain.com and connect a wallet.
2. Provide liquidity in a BPL pool (e.g. HONEY/BERA on BEX).
3. Stake the LP tokens in the reward vault to begin earning BGT.
4. Delegate accumulated BGT to a validator via the Boost screen.
5. Claim rewards every Monday from the Rewards tab.
6. Re-stake or rotate to higher-APR validators as incentives shift.

faqs.question: Is BGT transferable?
faqs.answer_md: No — BGT is soulbound to the wallet that earned it. It can only be redeemed for BERA or used to boost validators.

faqs.question: What is the minimum to participate?
faqs.answer_md: There is no hard minimum but expect gas + ~$50 in LP to make rewards meaningful.

faqs.question: Are rewards taxable?
faqs.answer_md: In most jurisdictions yes — boost emissions are treated as ordinary income at receipt. Consult a tax professional.

name: Sonic Labs Points Season 2
short_description: Sonic's S2 points program rewards activity on its high-speed EVM chain. Snapshot mid-September.
description_md: Following S1's $250M+ distribution, Sonic Labs has opened Season 2 of its points program. Points are earned for bridging assets, providing liquidity in whitelisted Sonic Gateway pools, and using Sonic-native dapps (SwapX, Beethoven X, Silo Finance V2). The S2 conversion ratio has been pre-announced at 200 points = 1 S token, with a hard cap on per-wallet allocations to combat sybils. Activity from S1 is not carried over — wallets must accrue fresh S2 points.
eligibility_md:
- Bridge to Sonic via the official Gateway
- Accumulate points by holding stablecoins (1 pt / $ / day) or whitelisted LPs (2.5 pts / $ / day)
- Use SwapX or Beethoven X for at least 3 swaps per week
- Minimum 50,000 points required to qualify
how_to_claim_md:
1. Bridge ETH or USDC to Sonic via https://gateway.soniclabs.com.
2. Park balance in a points-eligible vault — staked S, Silo USDC vault, etc.
3. Add LP on SwapX for the highest per-dollar rate.
4. Track your points via the official dashboard.
5. Snapshot is September 15, 2026 — keep position live until then.
6. Tokens will be claimable via the same dashboard 1-2 weeks after snapshot.

faqs.question: Did S1 actually distribute?
faqs.answer_md: Yes — Sonic's S1 distributed in early 2026 and trades on most major exchanges. S2 conditions are similar.

faqs.question: Is there a per-wallet cap?
faqs.answer_md: Yes — the team has indicated a soft cap around 1M points per wallet. Beyond that the marginal allocation tapers significantly.

name: Symbiotic
short_description: Permissionless restaking primitive backed by Paradigm. Deposit-cap based points program is live.
description_md: Symbiotic is a generalized restaking protocol that competes with EigenLayer by allowing any asset (not just ETH derivatives) to back AVS-style services. Backed by Paradigm with strong DeFi integrations (Mellow, Ether.fi, Pendle), the protocol's points program rewards depositors with 'Symbiotic Points' that are widely expected to convert at TGE. Deposits have been cap-gated, with multiple raises being filled within hours, indicating high pre-TGE demand.
eligibility_md:
- Deposit a supported asset (wstETH, cbETH, swETH, sUSDe) into Symbiotic vaults
- Maintain the position across at least one weekly epoch
- Optionally route through Mellow or Ether.fi for boosted multipliers
how_to_claim_md:
1. Visit app.symbiotic.fi.
2. Connect a wallet holding a supported asset.
3. Deposit into an available vault (subject to caps — refresh when caps open).
4. Optionally migrate to a Mellow vault for additional point multiplier.
5. Points are tracked on-chain and on the dashboard. Claim portal will be announced.

faqs.question: What's the conversion rate?
faqs.answer_md: Not announced. Comparable protocols (EigenLayer, Ether.fi) saw 0.1–1% of point value distributed at TGE.

faqs.question: Can I withdraw early?
faqs.answer_md: Yes, but exiting before snapshot forfeits accumulated multipliers.

name: Polymarket Trader Rewards
short_description: Polymarket's recent funding round and US-relisting put a token launch firmly on the table. Active traders are the obvious airdrop target.
description_md: Polymarket completed a $200M+ funding round in early 2026 and re-entered the US market via QCX acquisition. Vitalik Buterin and Anthropic founders have publicly endorsed the platform. While the team has not committed to a token, the combination of regulatory clarity, large funding, and competitor (Kalshi) momentum suggests a token launch is increasingly likely. Volume traders are the highest-probability beneficiaries. Geographic eligibility may vary at TGE.
eligibility_md:
- Trade on Polymarket regularly (minimum ~$100/month volume historically used by similar protocols)
- Maintain a positive USDC.e balance on Polygon
- US users: Polymarket now accepts US traders post-QCX; jurisdiction may still affect token eligibility
how_to_claim_md:
1. Sign up at polymarket.com (KYC may be required for US users).
2. Deposit USDC to your Polymarket account.
3. Trade across diverse markets — political, sports, crypto. Diversity historically scores higher than volume in single market.
4. Continue trading through any pre-announced snapshot window.
5. Watch official channels — fake claim sites are extremely common for Polymarket; verify URLs.

faqs.question: Is a Polymarket token confirmed?
faqs.answer_md: No. But the structural setup (large raise, US relisting, growing volume) mirrors every prior crypto-native platform that issued a token within 12-18 months.

faqs.question: Will US users qualify?
faqs.answer_md: Unknown. Token-distribution geographic restrictions are separate from trading-platform restrictions and Polymarket has not commented.

name: Walrus
short_description: Mysten Labs' decentralized blob storage on Sui — testnet stakers and storage users are tracked for the WAL drop.
description_md: Walrus is a decentralized storage protocol built on Sui by Mysten Labs (the team behind Sui itself). It uses erasure coding (Red Stuff) to store large blobs at significantly lower cost than competitors like Filecoin or Arweave. The team has confirmed a WAL token launch and an initial community distribution targeting testnet storage users, validators, and Sui ecosystem participants. Snapshot is June 30 2026.
eligibility_md:
- Hold and stake SUI through a Walrus-eligible validator
- Upload at least 100MB of test blobs to the Walrus testnet
- Run a Walrus storage node (advanced — Linux required)
how_to_claim_md:
1. Acquire SUI on a CEX or DEX and bridge to Sui mainnet.
2. Visit walrus.xyz and connect a Sui wallet.
3. Upload test data via the Walrus CLI or UI.
4. Wait for snapshot, then claim on the official portal after TGE.

faqs.question: Is the WAL drop confirmed?
faqs.answer_md: Yes — Mysten Labs has formally announced WAL with an explicit community distribution component.

name: Humanity Protocol
short_description: Palm-scan biometric proof-of-humanity. KYC-style verification required, but verified humans earn daily H credits.
description_md: Humanity Protocol uses palm-vein recognition to issue sybil-resistant proof-of-personhood credentials, competing directly with Worldcoin. Verified users earn daily H token credits convertible at TGE. Because the verification is biometric, KYC-style data is collected — this is the major caveat for privacy-conscious users.
eligibility_md:
- Verify with a Humanity Protocol Verifier (in-app palm scan)
- Open the app daily to claim H credits
- Refer additional verified humans for boosted credits
how_to_claim_md:
1. Install the Humanity Protocol app from your phone's app store.
2. Complete the palm-vein verification at a Verifier (in-person required in some regions).
3. Open the app every 24h to claim accruing H credits.
4. Claim portal will activate at TGE; tokens issued to the verified address.

faqs.question: Is biometric data stored?
faqs.answer_md: Humanity Protocol claims biometric data is processed locally and only a zero-knowledge commitment is stored on-chain. Critics dispute the strength of these guarantees.

faqs.question: Is this safe for me?
faqs.answer_md: Only you can decide. Biometric data, once leaked, cannot be reset. We provide no recommendation either way.

name: Linea Surge
short_description: ConsenSys's zkEVM has no token yet. Linea Surge LXP-L points and ecosystem TVL programs are the most likely qualifier paths.
description_md: Linea is ConsenSys's zkEVM rollup. It has not yet announced a native token, but the team runs an active points program (LXP-L) tied to provable on-chain actions and a 'Surge' program tied to TVL bridged into Linea-native DeFi (Lynex, Mendi, etc.). MetaMask-native integration positions Linea for a large eventual user base.
eligibility_md:
- Bridge ETH to Linea via the canonical bridge
- Provide liquidity in Linea Surge-eligible pools
- Hold LXP and LXP-L points (earned through Galxe quests and on-chain activity)
how_to_claim_md:
1. Bridge ETH at bridge.linea.build.
2. Complete monthly Galxe quests at linea.build/hub.
3. Provide LP in Lynex or Mendi.
4. Watch for the eventual token announcement.

faqs.question: Has Linea confirmed a token?
faqs.answer_md: No. Joseph Lubin (ConsenSys) has hedged on the question publicly but the LXP/LXP-L point design strongly resembles a pre-TGE accumulation system.

name: TapSwap Season 3
short_description: Telegram tap-to-earn mini-app, S3 cohort. Low effort, low EV — but qualifying takes 5 minutes a day.
description_md: TapSwap is a Telegram-native tap-to-earn game on TON. S1 distributed real tokens; S2 was modest; S3 is now active. Expected value per wallet is small ($5-$50 typical) but the time investment is correspondingly low. Useful as a 'free shot' in a diversified airdrop strategy.
eligibility_md:
- Have a Telegram account in good standing (not freshly created)
- Mine taps daily and complete the daily checklist
- Connect a TON wallet (Tonkeeper or similar) for claim
how_to_claim_md:
1. Open https://t.me/tapswap_bot inside Telegram.
2. Mine taps each day until energy depletes.
3. Complete the daily quests for boosters.
4. Connect a TON wallet before snapshot.
5. Claim is automatic to the connected wallet post-snapshot.

faqs.question: Are tap-to-earn drops worth my time?
faqs.answer_md: Marginally. Expect $5-$50 for 5 min/day over a few months. Skip if your time is worth more than that hourly.
